name: BUMANI_CIC
description: Climate Information Corpus for English–Bambara, English–Hausa, and English–Mooré terminology.
notes: Each CSV contains 1,633 bilingual records plus a header row.
Bambara and Mooré each contain 1,633 unique case-normalized English headwords.
Hausa contains 1,632 unique case-normalized English headwords across 1,633 records.
The three-language strict case-normalized English intersection contains 1,608 headwords.
git_blob_sha values are Git object identifiers for the files in this repository, not SHA-256 checksums.
